text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown Prince Hassan congratulates Christians on Christmas.
- Parliament to continue lengthy debates on the draft 1997 budget on Saturday.
- Next Wednesday is a public holiday to mark New Year.
- Prime Minister Kabariti discusses with a visiting Algerian delegation bilateral ties in the medical field, and expresses Jordan's readiness to hospitalise Algerians in Jordanian medical centres.
- Eleven Jordanians who were injured in a road accident in Saudi Arabia on Wednesday leave hospital after their conditions improve but three are still getting treatment.
- A cold front will hit the kingdom on Saturday, with the weather on Friday warm and above normal.
